purpose: Final explicit strict_tool smoke test on normal natural inputs; not a second prompt refinement and not a promotion to production auto.

samples.numbers_conditions: Forty-five/five minutes and English-question alternatives retained.
samples.note: Short source uses all seven slots, with a related preparation theme and question alternatives split across points. New supporting conditions are not pure duplicates.

facts.note: Both entering grades and private comments now explicit.

accuracy_issues.note: Cultural contrast remains a generic culture assertion rather than clearly the instructor's illustrative view.

samples.note: Provider returned required fields and seven slot values, but final point was 294 characters. Local validator correctly refused. Raw failed output is evidence, not a delivered summary or a valid complete quality result.

limitations: One normal-input run per sample, agent fact review only, no external human rating or complete claim-level accuracy guarantee.
